name: spoke outcomes
description: How do spokes END, and what does the drain cost to get there? The #231 outcome family (landed / blocked / reaped / abandoned) and the #280 throughput family had scores/tags but ZERO widgets — this dashboard charts them. The governance widget is 'Cost by model': it breaks generation cost down by providedModelName so a banned tier (the opus-4-8[1m] model-config leaks, #291/#305/#306) shows up as a bar — a snapshot copy plus a daily time-series copy for drift-over-time. Also: terminal outcomes, per-stage overhead, drain KPIs, and per-script success rate + volume. SCOPE THE DASHBOARD to environment=production (the store holds ~10k fixture sessions; use the dashboard-level Environment selector) or every widget mixes fixtures into the numbers. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES the normalization family (files_changed / lines_changed / commits / cost_per_changed_line): #344 (open) documents those emit false zeros on every land, so charting them before #344 lands poisons the view — add them only after #344. Saved once via the Langfuse UI (v3.192.x has no public dashboards API); each widget's metricsQuery is the exact /api/public/metrics query that backs it — add fromTimestamp/toTimestamp when running one. See docs/telemetry-pull-layer.md.
